key_idea: Each item has at most one owner and one wanter, so linking each person to the owner of the item they want gives a graph with in/out degree at most 1; the answer is the longest cycle.
sketch: Build next[i] = the person who has what i wants (via a map from item to owner). From every person follow next pointers up to n steps and record the cycle length if we return to the start; print the maximum length that is at least 2, otherwise 'No trades possible'. O(n^2) with n <= 100. Pitfalls: chains that are not closed do not count, and a trade needs at least two distinct people.
